g.text: SOFTWARE-DEFINED VEHICLE (SDV) - MASTER HARDWARE CIRCUIT SCHEMATIC
ESP32-S3 Cabin Node IoT Environmental Sensing & Coloured LED Actuator Matrix | FH Technikum Wien
PCNT Unit 0: Tachometer Pulse Accumulator (2 P/R)
CHANNEL 1: PURGE VENTILATION / COOLING ACTUATOR (BLOWER MOTOR EMULATION)
LEDC Timer 0 | 25.0 kHz Ultrasonic Carrier | 1024 Discrete Duty Steps | Failsafe Duty: 50%
CHANNEL 2: PTC CABIN HEATER CORE ACTUATOR
Digital DO | Active when Temperature < 19.0 °C (Comfort Deficit Threshold)
P_res = 5.94 mW | Emulates PTC Heating Element
Digital DO | Active under Air-Quality Equilibrium (CO₂ < 800 ppm, 20.0°C - 23.5°C)
Digital DO | Active when Relative Humidity > 65% RH or Bridge AE Reports DEGRADED State
P_res = 5.12 mW | Emulates A/C Evaporator Reheat
